top_findings.title: team_statistics silently truncates aggregation to 50 matches (default limit)
top_findings.evidence: lib/brazilian_soccer_mcp/query.ex:14 calls matches(catalog, Map.put(filters,"team",team)) with no limit; matches/2 applies limit/2 (query.ex:134) which defaults to 50 when filters["limit"] is nil. standings (query.ex:73) and competition_statistics (query.ex:83) explicitly pass limit 100_000, but team_statistics and head_to_head (query.ex:45) do not.
top_findings.suggestion: Force an unbounded limit for aggregation paths (e.g. Map.put_new(filters,"limit",1_000_000)) as standings/competition_statistics already do, so W/L/D and goals-for/against reflect the full match set, not just the 50 most recent.
